messages:
maria: Quick Q — AF release tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PDT. Who is allowed to press prod if the primary deployer is OOO? I see deploy-bot blocked Sam's attempt earlier :thinking:

sam: that's me — I tried a dry-run and hit 'permission denied'. I had JIT approved last week, but MFA prompt didn't come up.

deploy-bot: SYSTEM: release 2026.03.21-af scheduled. Action required: deploy permission check failed for user sam. Reason: missing active MFA session.

oliver: @carla any chance the MFA session TTL was shortened in the recent auth changes?

carla: we rolled in stricter TTLs for service accounts last Thursday — user sessions unaffected, but JIT grant flow changed. :lock:

dave: oncall — if primary can't press, fallback is 'deploy-rota' role or breakglass flow. Reminder: breakglass needs 2 approvals + audit note.

sam: how do I check if my JIT approval exists? I only see the one-time link expired.

maria: your JIT link expires after 12h now. Steps: 1) request JIT via /request-jit release-id 2) approve in Okta 3) confirm MFA. Example command we use in runbook:
```
# request access
/release-jit AF-2026-03-21 --reason "pressing prod"
```

carla: if JIT fails, call @dave + @oliver for manual approval and note the audit ID. We'll update runbook to show exact Okta screen.

oliver: action: I'll add a short note in the release notes and the deploy runbook about the increased MFA TTL and the emergency fallback procedure. ETA 2h.

maria: thanks. For immediate fix, @sam try re-requesting JIT and ensure your MFA device is enrolled. If still blocked, @oliver will step in. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: NOTE: any manual 'breakglass' actions will be logged under audit://release/1761234567

sam: done — re-requested JIT, got Okta approval, MFA prompted, I can press in dry-run now. Will go live only with @oliver present.

maria: perfect. closing loop — @oliver please confirm you'll be available 08:45 PDT for handoff. If not, @dave will cover.

oliver: confirmed. I'll be on standby 08:45-11:30 PDT. Leaving a comment in the release doc.

maria: great — I'll also add a one-liner to the release notes about the MFA change so customers aren't surprised by new UI.

carla: I'll file a short postmortem if any permissions friction occurs; prefer that to surprises during the window. :memo:
